text.title: Orchid Cinema
text.declared_genre: Indietronica / Cinematic Ambient Bass / Deep Dub
text.production_notes: Wide cinematic electrodub meditation, Huge heavy choir-like synth pads, Low sub pulses, Reversed piano, Synthetic bird-like tones, Film-reel flutter as the only aged texture, Smeared vocal chops, Long reverb tails, Slow dub drums, Dense luminous low end, Wonder with a hint of unease, Orchid chamber blooming into moving images
text.vocal_notes: Soft awed androgynous vocal, Human and unglossy, Close verses against vast choruses, Smeared vocal chops as distant texture, Gentle harmonies that feel luminous but uneasy, Emotional restraint throughout
